DecisionState.title: DecisionState
DecisionState.description: GET of the one current decision; `decision` is "pending" (and the rest null) while nothing is decided.

EngineUpdate.title: EngineUpdate
EngineUpdate.description: Partial update: only the fields that are sent change. `cloud_api_key` is write-only ("" removes it).

GraphOverview.title: GraphOverview
GraphOverview.description: Publish status as in PublishStatus; when the graph cannot be reached `reachable` is false and `error` says why (the call itself does not fail).

JiraRef.title: JiraRef
JiraRef.description: Where an imported requirement comes from. `url` is the issue in the Jira site (empty when the site is not known).

JiraStatus.title: JiraStatus
JiraStatus.description: `not_configured` (the server has no Jira app settings), `not_connected`, `connected`, `expired` (connect again). Tokens are never part of any response.

Pipeline.title: Pipeline
Pipeline.description: Where the project stands, in five stages; each has a state and the numbers behind it.

PublishDocsIn.title: PublishDocsIn
PublishDocsIn.description: Publish or unpublish documents: the listed ones, every analysed document of a sprint, or both.

PublishIn.title: PublishIn
PublishIn.description: Optional and only a check: a project is always published under its own key and name, so these may be omitted or must equal them (else 422).

PublishSync.title: PublishSync
PublishSync.description: What happened to the sync that runs right after: `synced`, `not_configured` (nothing to sync with) or `retrying` (it will be tried again by itself).

SprintUpdate.title: SprintUpdate
SprintUpdate.description: Send only what changes; `phase_id: null` takes the sprint out of its phase.

Suggestion.title: Suggestion
Suggestion.description: Rule-based hint, computed on every request and never stored: accept | edit | reject, with the reasons in plain words.

SyncStatus.title: SyncStatus
SyncStatus.description: Background sync of the project to the graph database. `pending` and `retrying` come with `next_attempt_at`.
